get.description: This endpoint preserves three response branches. scope=catalog (context omitted or global) returns CatalogSearchOutput. Other explicit non-global contexts, or context=global&envelope=1, return ScopedSearchOutput. Remaining requests return LegacyGlobalSearchOutput; omitting context also emits Deprecation and Warning headers. Catalog filters use repeated query parameters, AND across fields and OR within a field, on the same activated public edition. Parameter defaults and validation differ by branch; see each parameter description.

parameters.name: access
parameters.description: Catalog: readable or metadata. Legacy global: online or download.

parameters.name: context
parameters.description:
scope=catalog accepts global only. Other non-global contexts return the scoped envelope. Omitting context uses the deprecated legacy global response.

* `works` - works
* `scholars` - scholars
* `disciplines` - disciplines
* `subdisciplines` - subdisciplines
* `theories` - theories
* `topics` - topics
* `reading_paths` - reading_paths
* `global` - global

parameters.name: discipline
parameters.description: Scoped subdisciplines, theories, topics or reading_paths only.

parameters.name: envelope
parameters.description: With an explicit global context, the literal value 1 selects the scoped envelope. Ignored for scope=catalog.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Scoped envelope page limit, default 24. Ignored by catalog and legacy global.

parameters.name: match
parameters.description: Catalog only. Repeat the parameter for multiple values. Defaults to title, author, keyword, abstract.

parameters.name: node_type
parameters.description: Scoped theories only, when type is absent.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Defaults to 1. Catalog rejects values over 100000; legacy/scoped branches normalize invalid values.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Catalog defaults to 24. Legacy defaults to 8 for scope=all, otherwise 24. Scoped envelope uses this only when limit is absent.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Catalog and explicit context searches accept at most 500 characters; catalog also limits whitespace-separated terms to 20.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: catalog selects the snapshot-backed catalog response. Legacy global uses all by default, or book, article, thesis, report, scholar, topic, theory, fulltext to select pagination totals.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
Catalog and legacy global only; defaults to relevance.

* `relevance` - relevance
* `newest` - newest
* `year` - year

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Legacy global only.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Scoped theories node type; takes precedence over node_type.

parameters.name: visibility
parameters.description:
Scoped envelope only. admin is honored only for authorized staff or admin/editor/reviewer accounts; otherwise public is used.

* `public` - public
* `admin` - admin

get.description:
Serve one current normalized PDF to authenticated back-office staff.

This endpoint deliberately bypasses only the publication-state filter. It
keeps the existing file-path, X-Accel and Range safeguards, and forces
private no-store caching so draft assets never enter a shared cache.
